---
name: Documentation issue
about: A documentation page is missing, unclear, or out of date (including OS menu wording that has changed)
title: "[Docs] "
labels: documentation
assignees: ''
---

## Which page(s)

Link to the page(s) in `docs/` and/or `documents/`, or the `.docx` guide.

## What's wrong or missing

For an out-of-date OS menu step (Switch Access, Switch Control, or similar): which OS/device version did you test on, and what's different from what's documented?

## Suggested fix

If you already know what the correct text should be, include it here. Otherwise, just describe the problem — that's still useful.

## Did you check both `docs/` and `documents/`?

This project keeps a Jekyll-published copy (`docs/`) and a packaging-friendly copy (`documents/`) in sync — see `CONTRIBUTING.md`. Please note if the issue affects one, the other, or both.
